notes.note: Delta review 2 on #5007: the finished-session park conditions now state the foreign-hook rule, the Claude Code version floor and the result-steer exception. Foreign hooks: ClaudeAdapter runs with includeHookEvents, and any hook_started marks a hook Station did not install, sticky for the engine. EXECUTED probe against the bundled Claude Code 2.1.322: an async or asyncRewake settings Stop hook reports hook_started before the result and hook_response when it ends, while an SDK callback reports none. Version floor: parseClaudeCodeVersion against 2.1.322. Result-steer exception: a steer with Station's internal actor and the delegation-result sender is excluded from hasPersonTurn. The remaining unseen mechanisms are listed. The delegation-result delivery section elsewhere on the page is unchanged. Covered by claude-adapter-early-park and finished-session-parking tests, fault-injected (H1-H4, S1-S2).
